WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average_price
  FROM Products
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_average_price, oa.overall_average_price
  FROM type_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE oa.overall_average_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ta.type_average_price > oa.overall_average_price
), above_kept_mean AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, type_average_price, overall_average_price
  FROM above_overall
  WHERE type_average_price > (SELECT AVG(type_average_price) FROM above_overall)
)
SELECT AVG(type_average_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(type_average_price - overall_average_price) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(type_average_price - (SELECT AVG(type_average_price) FROM above_overall)) AS average_above_kept_mean
FROM above_kept_mean;
